title: Warning: Rule '<every remote repository rule>' indicated that a canonical reproducible form can be obtained by dropping arguments ["generator_name", "generator_function"]

labels.name: P0
labels.description: This is an emergency and more important than other current work. (Assignee required)

body:
I'm seeing these warnings for every remote repository rule on Bazel@HEAD (5c1c0d1ed8643c90fba239d1bc642e4ebd044c2c).

Here are the warnings for [gitiles](https://gerrit.googlesource.com/gitiles) repository:
